worldcombat.skill.painsplit.summary: Tie a thread of pain, drain a slice from whoever has more life (never fatally), then give what was actually drained to whoever has less; no drain, no gift. Either side may end up paying.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.use.0: Level the gap when your life is far below the foe's
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.use.1: Drain a slice from a high-health target to mend yourself
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.use.2: Pick a wounded ally and spend your own life to give it back
Tie a thread of pain to a target within %1$s blocks with a clear line to you; the target may be an enemy or an explicitly chosen ally.
Tie the thread in %1$s, gather it in %2$s after the split, and a %3$s cooldown from commit.

It first drains a non-fatal slice from whoever has more life, reads the actual loss, then heals the lower side by at most that loss, capped at the average and at its maximum life; a refused drain gives nothing back. It can never be fatal - both stay at 1 point of life or more.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to tie the thread, then %3$s seconds to gather it in and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.growth.0: At level %1$s the thread reaches %2$s blocks and the cooldown becomes %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.growth.1: At level %1$s the thread reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.preference.a: Only tie the thread within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.

The healing this move can actually bring back, scaled by the larger of the two maximums, must reach this ratio before it is used. Higher is pickier, casting only when the gap and the room to receive are both big; lower casts more often.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to tie the thread. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
On: when its own life is higher than a wounded ally's, it will tie the thread and spend its own life to mend the ally. Off: it only uses the move on enemies and never pays life for an ally.
